title: Spectroscopic signatures of interfacial energy transfer in MoS2-based van der Waals heterostructures under deep-UV excitation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,37183-37193
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04686F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Tsung-Hsien Lee, Sheng-Lung Chou, Tzu-Ping Huang, Chak-Ming Liu, Chih-Hao Chin, Meng-Yeh Lin, Hui-Fen Chen, Yu-Jong Wu
We report a comprehensive photoluminescence (PL) and photoluminescence excitation (PLE) study of monolayer MoS2 and its van der Waals heterostructures with hBN and graphene under deep-ultraviolet (DUV) excitation.
